independent_critical_interpretation_corr.scope: append-only correction; read-only fixed Git source and retained originals; no Go/SSH/replay

source_chain.fact: Slot acquisition failure increments rejected and calls the same h.write with HTTP 429, without owning an export slot.
h.write sends status/body and Flush; any Write/Flush error is passed to h.failure without request identity or status classification.
h.failure increments the shared Exports timeout when net.Error.Timeout is true, including errors on the 429 path.
Acquired requests release their slot on return and may also increment the same timeout counter. The aggregate counter does not distinguish these requests from rejected writes.

independent_critical_interpretation_corr.corrected_conclusion: The post-critical HTTP 200 proves that at least one exporter slot was available when that request acquired it. The aggregate timeout count of 2 cannot be assigned to the two original slot-owning HTTP 200 writers, and does not prove that both timed out or released their slots.
independent_critical_interpretation_corr.withdrawn_inference: Do not infer two original occupied writers naturally timed out/released from timeout delta 0 to 2; do not present bounded writer timeout as the established cause of the observed 200.
independent_critical_interpretation_corr.unresolved: Which request(s) incremented timeout, the original writers release times, and continuous two-slot occupancy throughout critical work are not established by the retained aggregate counters.
independent_critical_interpretation_corr.verdict_unchanged: The actual post-critical status is 200, violating the fixed post-critical 429 assertion. The original failure remains; no product timing failure or successful overlap is inferred. PostgreSQL findings are unaffected.
